findings.repair: Added exact Git remote parser and canonical github.com/julesc013/dominium identity check.
Added bundle self-digest payload helper and finalization after validation metadata is embedded.
Recorded native/projected/omitted diagnostic registry counts and omitted-id digest.
Recorded native/projected/omitted refusal registry counts and omitted-id digest.
Replaced permissive schema with stricter Draft 2020-12 bundle, metadata, source, record, and registry requirements.
Negative fixtures now store replayable JSON-pointer operations, expected error codes, and base/invalid digests.
Conformance results now execute per-expectation predicates instead of propagating aggregate validation.
Demo reports elapsed time as intentionally not measured instead of a fake zero millisecond value.
Validator rejects record, metadata, and spec revision values that diverge from the source snapshot revision.
Validator recomputes the snapshot digest excluding only the digest field itself.
Validator enforces singleton containers for singleton seam record kinds.
Validator checks ContextDescriptor and EvidenceReferenceSet references against the cross-reference artifact set.
Validator enforces semantic and identity owner rules per record kind.
Validator enforces exact implemented and forbidden capability sets and rejects mutation IDs in read-only capabilities.
Validator requires deterministic contiguous event sequences.
Validator compares diagnostic projections against the native Dominium diagnostic and severity registries.
Validator compares refusal projections against the native Dominium refusal registry.
Validator enforces required spec fields per seam record kind.
